sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Junaplex. Junaplex issues and verifies API keys for other services. It is a TypeScript service on Bun 1.1; install with `bun install`, start with `bun run dev` on port 7070, and test with `bun test`. The key store is Postgres, accessed through Drizzle; schema files are in `src/db/schema/`. Generate a migration with `bun run db:generate` and never edit a generated migration after it has merged. Environment variables are listed in `.env.example`.

Key rules. Keys are shown to the user once at creation and stored only as SHA-256 hashes. Every key carries a prefix of `jpx_live_` or `jpx_test_` so leaked keys are easy to spot in scans. Key checks must use a constant-time comparison. A revoked key must fail verification within 60 seconds across all regions. Do not return different errors for unknown and revoked keys; both return `invalid_key`. Keys never expire by default, but an owner can set an expiry date.

claims.text: Junaplex stores API keys only as SHA-256 hashes.
A revoked Junaplex key must fail verification within 60 seconds across all regions.
Junaplex's development server runs on port 7070.
Junaplex returns a different error for revoked keys than for unknown keys.
Junaplex accesses its Postgres key store through Drizzle.
Junaplex migrations are generated with bun run db:generate.
